subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr saved Sequoia and Zinnia after they were knocked out.
source_quote: I saved Sequoia and Zinnia.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr attempted to retrieve Calmer’s body but was interrupted by Thalsor.
source_quote: And then just as I was about to get Calmer’s body, Thalsor killed him.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia recognized that Thalsor intended to mutilate Calmer’s body to prevent resurrection.
source_quote: The bastard will mutilate the body, making it impossible to raise him from the dead.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia concluded that Thalsor must die to prevent exposure of their identities to the cult.
source_quote: Thalsor needs to die.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia stared at Calmer’s wounds and said they would act tomorrow.
source_quote: Sequoia stares at his wounds, "Tomorrow."

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr shouted to Thalsor that they would negotiate tomorrow.
source_quote: Zephyr shouts, "We’ll negotiate tomorrow, Thalsor."

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor screamed his plans to kill, mutilate, and destroy, promising retribution of earth and evil.
source_quote: Thalsor screams his plans to kill and mutilate and destroy and promises the retribution of earth and evil

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia observed Sequoia gliding toward Calmer’s corpse using a potion of gaseous form.
source_quote: Sequoia has taken position with his potion of gaseous form. He glides towards Calmer’s corpse.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia materialized, grabbed Calmer’s body, and ran.
source_quote: Sequoia materializes, grabs calmer’s body and runs.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia struck Thalsor during the surprise attack, helping to kill him quickly.
source_quote: My attacks and Zephyr’s attacks strike him down quickly.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr took a position to attack Thalsor with bows during the assault.
source_quote: Zephyr will take a position where he can attack with bows.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia realized that without Calmer’s spells, they could not kill the golem and shifted focus to killing Thalsor.
source_quote: Without Calmer’s spells we can’t kill the golem, so we focus on killing Thalsor.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr believes the attackers were not random bandits but cultists of earth.
source_quote: These were not some random bandits. Lareth said some random bandits stole a chest. These are cultists of earth.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia understands that Lareth sent them to eliminate rivals and increase his own power.
source_quote: The various elemental factions are at each other’s throats. Lareth wants to get rid of the competition. He sent us here to get rid of his enemies. We just made him more powerful.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia secured notes indicating the lost chest was located in a monastery within the mountains.
source_quote: we secured the stolen honey from Pasmarie Clee and, crucially, found notes indicating the lost chest was located in a monastery within the mountains

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia gave up a magical trident as a tithe to Terjon to revive Calmer.
source_quote: I made the difficult decision to give up a magical trident, offering it as a tithe to Terjon at the Temple of St. Cuthbert

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia visited Jaroo, who warned that Terjon’s followers might withhold healing from non-followers.
source_quote: We also made sure to visit Jaroo, who reiterated the importance of securing the chest, noting that the Terjon (implied to be followers of St. Cuthbert like Terjon) might withhold healing magic from non-followers.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia learned from Robert Deakin that the chest’s true purpose was to secure a treaty with Celene to wage war on the gnomes.
source_quote: He unveiled a fascinating theory: the chest's true purpose was to secure a treaty with the Kingdom of Celene. The Viscounty (Verbobonc) intended to use this alliance to wage war on the gnomes and seize their gem mines.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia learned that the elves at Caer Ostverk and Lord Denelu were willing to pay for information on the chest’s location.
source_quote: It was also rumored that the elves at Caer Ostverk and Lord Denelu were willing to pay well for information on the chest's location.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia learned Robert Deakin was related to the Clee family.
source_quote: Deakin mentioned he was related to the Clee family (our honey purveyors in Sheernobb)

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia learned from Rithelm Drake that an abandoned monastery near Gallow's Corner was the likely location of the chest.
source_quote: he eventually recalled an abandoned monastery near Gallow's Corner

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia encountered Gonnathrad Kevanarial, a High Elf Diplomat who wanted to be a quest giver.
source_quote: Gonnathrad Kevanarial, a High Elf Diplomat... became overly excited at the prospect of being a "quest giver"

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia received a letter of permit from Gonnathrad Kevanarial, officially hiring them to pursue the chest near Gallow's Corner.
source_quote: he issued us a letter of permit, officially hiring us to pursue a lead regarding the chest near a monastery by Gallow's Corner

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia was promised 100 gold pieces upon presenting the letter to Caer Ostverk.
source_quote: It promised 100 gold pieces as a reward when presented to Caer Ostverk.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr learned from Robert Deakin that the talk of 'big evil powers' was a cover for bandits.
source_quote: Deakin, though, had his own theories, arguing that the talk of "big evil powers" was just a cover for bandits

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr learned from Rithelm Drake that he had once considered being an adventurer but settled for family life.
source_quote: he lamented that he'd once considered being an adventurer himself before settling down with a wife and three kids.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr received a letter of permit from Gonnathrad Kevanarial, officially hiring them to pursue the chest near Gallow's Corner.
source_quote: he actually gave us a letter of permit... officially hiring us to pursue the chest near the monastery at Gallow's Corner

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr was eager to leave Ostverk quickly to avoid drawing attention to his appearance.
source_quote: I, for one, was eager to leave Ostverk as quickly as possible. In a town full of people with agendas, the less attention drawn to us, the better, especially with my appearance.

subject: the chest Lareth wanted
fact: The chest Lareth wanted has not yet been recovered; its location is known to be in a monastery in the mountains, but retrieval has not occurred in this session.
source_quote: We now need to get what we came for, the chest Lareth wanted.

subject: the honey that Pasmarie Clee was looking for
fact: The honey that Pasmarie Clee was looking for has been recovered and returned, but its original loss and full significance remain unexplored.
source_quote: We now need to get what we came for, the chest Lareth wanted. And the honey that Pasmarie Clee was looking for.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia observed that Thalsor was wounded and unwilling to leave his compound.
source_quote: He’s wounded too. And he doesn’t want to die.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia noted that the golem was immobile after Thalsor’s death.
source_quote: The golem is immobile.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia confirmed Calmer’s body was intact and could be raised.
source_quote: Calmer’s dead body is on the ground. Intact. It can be raised.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr looked around after the battle and turned to Zinnia to say the attackers were cultists.
source_quote: Zephyr is looking around and turns to me and says, "These were not some random bandits. Lareth said some random bandits stole a chest. These are cultists of earth."

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia looked at Zephyr and realized Lareth had manipulated them to eliminate rivals.
source_quote: I look at him and it clicks, "The various elemental factions are at each other’s throats. Lareth wants to get rid of the competition. He sent us here to get rid of his enemies. We just made him more powerful."
